sources.title: PDF NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU Liquid Cold Plate · Dual-Slot
sources.snippet: T-HS202305 Dual-slot copper cold plate for the RTX 4090, 29.7 mm total height. Deeper channel core holds 450 W below 55 °C at 35 °C inlet (20 K rise, ≈ 0.044 °C/W) at only 0.5 LPM — half the flow of the single-slot version — with 34% EGW and 8 kPa. Best choice for low-flow loops or when pump / CDU capacity is shared across many GPUs.
